HrmSubCompany.sql: WITH org_scope(id,depth,visited) AS (SELECT id,0,CAST('/'+CAST(id AS varchar(20))+'/' AS varchar(4000)) FROM dbo.[HrmSubCompany] WHERE id IN ({company_ids}) UNION ALL SELECT p.id,s.depth+1,CAST(s.visited+CAST(p.id AS varchar(20))+'/' AS varchar(4000)) FROM org_scope s JOIN dbo.[HrmSubCompany] c ON c.id=s.id JOIN dbo.[HrmSubCompany] p ON p.id=c.[supsubcomid] WHERE s.depth<32 AND CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(p.id AS varchar(20))+'/',s.visited)=0) SELECT [id] AS [id],[subcompanyname] AS [subcompanyname],[subcompanydesc] AS [subcompanydesc],[supsubcomid] AS [supsubcomid],[canceled] AS [canceled] FROM dbo.[HrmSubCompany] WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM org_scope)

reading_rules.scope: typed fixed-query closure; never execute stored SQL
reading_rules.identifiers: preserve signed form ids and separate source namespaces
reading_rules.registries: modern/legacy candidates preserved independently; no inferred priority
reading_rules.external: no external connection; nonempty datasource ids treated unverified
reading_rules.physical: sys metadata only; resolve schema ambiguity before adapting dictionary
